passages.locator: Fineware workshop, table 1, and consumption contexts
passages.note: The workshop contained more than a thousand moulds, clay, tools and combustion traces across three Moche IV floors, with 300 square metres excavated incompletely. Matched moulds indicate some products reached site residences; authors infer social organization rather than directly observing it.
